slots_and_copies.name: header
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy, no backup. Validated at boot by FUN_0802ef8c (record i16 sum == 0 and 8-byte magic compare); on failure FUN_0802efe8 recreates it via FUN_0802f484 and blanks all slots instead of falling back to a copy.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Addressed explicitly by index: EEPROM byte offset (slot * 0x13 + 5) * 8 = 40 + slot * 152 (FUN_0802f410). Valid iff FUN_0802f460 RAM-domain signed i16 sum over 152 bytes == 0 (FUN_0802f3e4). No generation counter or newest-wins selection.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Addressed explicitly by index: (1 * 0x13 + 5) * 8 = 192 (FUN_0802f410). Valid iff RAM-domain signed i16 sum over 152 bytes == 0 (FUN_0802f3e4).

slots_and_copies.name: slot_2
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Addressed explicitly by index: (2 * 0x13 + 5) * 8 = 344 (FUN_0802f410). Valid iff RAM-domain signed i16 sum over 152 bytes == 0 (FUN_0802f3e4).

slots_and_copies.name: tail_unused
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Never addressed by any traced read or write; all 0xFF in both samples.

checksums.name: header_sum16_zero
checksums.formula_detail: In-RAM record transform first: RAM_block[j] = file_block[7-j] for each 8-byte EEPROM block. Then S = sum of all 20 signed little-endian i16 words of the 40-byte header record with 16-bit signed wrap (FUN_0802f460). Record is valid iff S == 0. Stored checksum is RAM word 7 at RAM offset 0x0E, written as -(sum of the other 19 words after zeroing word 7) by FUN_0802ef20 and FUN_0802f484; in file order it occupies bytes 0x08-0x09 and reads big-endian (0x20F6 in cap-00, 0x1FF6 in cap-01). Direct little-endian sum over raw file bytes gives 254 on both samples and is rejected.

checksums.name: slot_sum16_zero
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_0802f460 core over the 152-byte slot record in RAM order (after the per-8-byte-block reversal): valid iff the signed i16 sum of all 76 words == 0, tested by FUN_0802f3e4 via FUN_0802f410 reads. Blank/init slots in both samples sum to 251 (slot 0), -5 (slot 1), 250 (slot 2) and are therefore invalid. The slot checksum-word index is not proven by any writer in the corpus; offset 54 (= slot_0 base 40 + file pair at base+8, i.e. RAM word 7 by header symmetry) is a hypothesis only, so stored/computed are reported for slot_0 under that hypothesis with match=false as observed for blank slots.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA transfer primitive: stores src/dst to consecutive DMA registers (consistent with DMA3 0x040000D4/0x040000D8), writes count|0x80000000 enable to control, busy-waits on control bit 0x8000, saves/restores bus control globals. Register bases are unresolved _DAT_ literals (static-only).

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: MSB-first serial command (address bits + start/opcode) DMAed to 0x0D000000 (addr_bits+3 halfwords), then 0x44 halfwords DMAed back and 4 u16 reconstructed MSB-first into reverse word order. Call from 0x0800cb20 confirmed in decompiled body; callgraph omits that callee edge.

EEPROM write one 8-byte block: serialises 4 u16 data (64 bits MSB-first) + address bits with start/stop framing, DMAs addr_bits+0x43 halfwords to 0x0D000000, polls EEPROM line (0x0D000000 & 1) with timer timeout (0x88 budget, 0xE4 wrap counter).
Write wrapper: calls FUN_08041c58(block, data, wait=1). Body-confirmed caller edge.
Verify: re-reads block via FUN_08041b94 and compares 4 i16; returns 0x8000 on mismatch, 0 on match. Used as write-verify after every block write.
Bus/chip-type select probe; argument 4 selects the configuration whose return value 0 means EEPROM present to FUN_0800cc00.
Session open / EEPROM identify: saves WAITCNT-style registers, returns FUN_08041acc(4)==0 gate.
Session close: restores the register saved by FUN_0800cc00.
Mid-level EEPROM read: byte offset/length >>3 to 8-byte blocks, per-block retry x3 on FUN_08041b94, returns 1 on full success. Callgraph callers agree exactly.
Mid-level EEPROM verified write: per block FUN_08041c44 write + FUN_08041db8 read-back verify, retry pair x3. Every EEPROM write in the game uses this path. Callgraph callers agree exactly.
Wrapping signed 16-bit sum of (len>>1) little-endian i16 words. Also inlined in FUN_0802ef8c (header, 0x28) and FUN_0802f484. Validity == sum 0.
Header validator: reads 40-byte header, requires i16 sum == 0, then 8-byte magic compare. Returns success flag.

Header flush: recomputes checksum word at RAM+0x0E as negated sum, compares RAM header vs EEPROM copy (10 x u32), writes via FUN_0800cb88 only if different. Caller edge body-confirmed; callgraph lists no callers.
Default header creator: memcpy 40-byte template (FUN_08028688), checksum word 7 = -sum, verified write at offset 0 size 0x28.

Boot init root (no callers in corpus): allocates 0x98 scratch (FUN_080284b8) at save-global+0x28, validates header, on failure writes default header, zeroes scratch, blanks 3 slots (0x90 bytes each, cumulative RAM 0xFF marker byte per slot), then loads slots via FUN_0802f37c.
Slot read: FUN_0800cb20((slot*0x13+5)*8, 0x98, *(save-global+0x28)).
Slot validity: FUN_0802f460(scratch, 0x98) == 0, stores bool at save-global+0x50+slot.
Loads/validates slots 0-2 (12-byte descriptors), on valid slot copies scratch pointer to +0x58, zeroes +0x5C, calls unresolved func_0x0801b788 deserialiser (body absent from corpus).
Memset helper; zeroes 0x98 scratch buffer (FUN_0802f058) and 12-byte slot descriptors.
Memcpy helper; copies 40-byte default header template.
Zeroing malloc; allocates shared 152-byte scratch/slot buffer.

fields.name: magic
fields.update_mechanism: Static template bytes copied by FUN_0802f484 (FUN_08028688) and written with verified write; conditionally rewritten by FUN_0802ef20 only when the RAM header differs from EEPROM. RAM-domain byte order is reversed within the block (RAM: I2GBA003).
fields.evidence: Both .sav files start 33 30 30 41 42 47 32 49. FUN_0802ef8c performs an 8-byte compare after the zero-sum test (expected-pattern pointer is an unresolved literal, so code proves the compare, samples prove the bytes).

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: RAM offset 0x0E (word 7): zeroed, record summed by FUN_0802f460, negated sum stored. In file order the pair at 0x08 reads big-endian because of the per-8-byte-block reversal. Recomputed on every header flush; write suppressed if header unchanged.
fields.evidence: Python verification on both samples: computed -sum(others) == stored (0x20F6 / 0x1FF6) and whole-record RAM sum == 0. File offset 0x08 is the PACKET.md mutation-probe offset that reverted the save to blank.

fields.name: header_counter_like_byte
fields.update_mechanism: Changed 0x00->0x01 between the two consecutive captures (RAM byte 0x0B, high byte of RAM word 5); the header checksum compensated by -0x0100 in the same step. Direct writer not present in the traced corpus.
fields.evidence: Only differing payload byte between the samples (diff: file 0x0C 0x00->0x01, file 0x08 0x20->0x1F checksum compensation). Semantics unknown; no traced reader consumes it except via the record checksum.

fields.name: header_word_ram8
fields.update_mechanism: Static template word at RAM offset 0x08, covered by the header checksum; only rewritten wholesale by FUN_0802f484/FUN_0802ef20.
fields.evidence: Identical in both samples and part of the zero-sum template. Version/stamp or packed-pair semantics unprovable from this corpus; no direct reader.

fields.name: header_reserved
fields.update_mechanism: Zero template bytes, covered by the header checksum. FUN_0801bcb4 packed-settings copies touch offsets 8-13 of an unresolved-base struct; aliasing onto this header range is unproven.
fields.evidence: All zero in both samples; no field-level reader or writer identified.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip one magic byte (0x33->0x32) WITH header checksum repaired (recompute RAM word 7 at file pair 0x08)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If the FUN_0802ef8c 8-byte compare is a true magic gate: boot reinitialises to default header + blank slots and rewrites the file. If it loads, the compare is not independently enforced.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip one magic byte WITHOUT checksum repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Rejection via checksum alone (sum != 0); blank-revert and rewrite. Control discriminating magic vs checksum enforcement against the repaired variant.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Checksum high byte 0x20->0x21 (replicates PACKET.md probe offset 0x8)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Integrity failure, revert to blank, save rewritten (already confirmed once by the packet cold-reload probe).

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Counter-like byte 0x00->0x02 with header checksum repaired
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Loads unchanged with no boot rewrite if it is an unchecked counter/flag; a rewrite/clamp on boot reveals a validator in the absent deserialiser.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Clear slot 0 blank marker (file 0x2F: 0xFF->0x00), then repair slot 0 checksum under the word-7 hypothesis (file pair at 0x30)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If marker + checksum were the only blockers, FUN_0802f3e4 marks slot 0 valid and FUN_0802f37c invokes the slot deserialiser (observe menu/crash/state). Otherwise iterate the checksum-word index.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Write RAM-domain ascending-byte probe payload into slot 0, repair slot checksum, boot, trigger an in-game save, re-dump .sav
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Reveals the missing gameplay slot writer: overwritten bytes give the true payload layout, true checksum-word index, and flush size (check trailer at 0xB8).

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Zero slot 0 erased trailer (0xFF x8 -> 0x00 x8) on an otherwise checksum-repaired valid slot
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Slot must flip back to invalid without re-repair, proving the trailer block is summed by FUN_0802f3e4 rather than ignored.
No observable change and no rewrite; any delta falsifies the geometry (no code addresses >= 0x1F0).

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Static header word file bytes 07 09 -> 07 0A with header checksum repaired
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Behaviour/language/version change if HDR+0x08 is live; no change across menus indicates a passive template stamp. Pair with the FUN_08024198 options action to observe settings packing.

open_questions: Slot payload semantics are unknown: both samples contain only blank/invalid slots (RAM sums 251, -5, 250), and no gameplay slot writer call site (FUN_0800cb88 with a slot offset and populated data) exists in ghidra/decompiled.c. The runtime probe in fuzzing_targets (offset 40) is designed to capture it.
The slot checksum-word index is unproven (hypothesis: RAM word 7 at slot+0x0E, file pair at slot base+0x08, by header symmetry). Only the sum==0 validity rule (FUN_0802f3e4) is confirmed static.

Absolute RAM mirror addresses cannot be named: all save buffers are reached via unresolved literal-pool pointers (_DAT_0802ef7c, _DAT_0802efbc, _DAT_0802f4c0, *(save-global+0x28)); the ROM literal values are not in the corpus, so ram_addr is null for every field.
func_0x0801b788 (slot deserialiser called by FUN_0802f37c on valid slots) has no body among the 270 decompiled functions and no callgraph node; what a valid 152-byte slot expands into is unknown.

Whether the FUN_0801bcb4/FUN_0801bc94 packed-settings structs alias the EEPROM header buffer (offsets 4-13) is unresolved; in these samples the corresponding header range is a static word plus zeroes, so no settings encoding can be extracted.
Semantics of header RAM byte 0x0B (file 0x0C, 0x00->0x01 between captures) and RAM word at 0x08 (0x0709) are unknown; no traced reader consumes either except via the record checksum.

EEPROM chip descriptor values (capacity at desc+4, address-bit count at desc+8 in FUN_08041b94/FUN_08041c58) and the exact DMA register bases masked by _DAT_ literals in FUN_08041b14 are static-only; 6 address bits is inferred from the 512-byte media.
No paired .ss save states exist in this workspace (states/ is empty), so all fuzzing predictions are phrased for cold-boot .sav reload rather than save-state resume.
